title: CNF bounds from a decision tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $T$ be a decision tree on the Boolean cube $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with sign-valued outputs, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function. If evaluating $T$ on the coordinatewise binary encoding of each sign vector computes $f$, then $f$ has a conjunctive normal form with at most as many clauses as $T$ has leaves and with every clause containing at most $\mathrm{depth}(T)$ literals.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a decision tree on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with sign-valued outputs
$f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on $\{−1,1\}^n$
